aiox_gaps.description: gstack has a persistent Chromium daemon (server.ts, 2,407 LOC) with ref system (@e1, @e2) enabling <100ms browser commands. AIOX uses per-invocation Playwright which is 10-50x slower for multi-command sessions.
gstack /canary provides continuous post-deploy monitoring (console errors, perf regression, page failures). AIOX verify-deploy is one-time only — no continuous watch.
gstack /benchmark collects Core Web Vitals with before/after baselines. AIOX has performance scripts (.aiox-core/infrastructure/) but they're not wired into the story review flow.
gstack has 10 hardcoded AI-generated design anti-patterns + 7 litmus checks. AIOX relies on subjective agent judgment for design quality.
gstack generates skills for 8 AI hosts from 1 template. AIOX is locked to Claude Code. If market shifts to multi-model, AIOX has no adaptation path.
gstack gen-skill-docs.ts (658 LOC) with 9 resolvers, CI freshness check, token budget tracking. AIOX ide-sync generates stubs only.
gstack /autoplan chains CEO -> Eng -> Design -> DX reviews automatically. AIOX c-level agents must be invoked manually one-by-one.
gstack wrapError() rewrites Playwright errors into actionable agent guidance (strip stacks, add context). AIOX uses standard error patterns.

gstack_gaps.description: gstack has ETHOS.md (philosophy, no enforcement). No hooks, no CODEOWNERS, no mandatory gates. Any agent can push, modify, or delete anything.
gstack has no process mapping methodology. Skills are atomic and unrelated. No formal state machine, no checkpoints, no quality gates between phases.
gstack is single-project. No concept of business isolation, workspace layers, or cross-business governance. Cannot serve multi-tenant organizations.
gstack has TODOS.md (flat priority list). No stories, no epics, no lifecycle states, no acceptance criteria, no traceability to commits.
gstack_gaps.aiox_source: docs/stories/ (353 stories, 46 epics, full SDC lifecycle)

gstack_gaps.description: gstack appends to JSONL (L1 only). No promotion to decision-cards (L2) or heuristics (L3). No schema governance on learnings.
gstack Conductor is basic workspace cloning. No dependency graph, no effort routing, no circuit breakers, no batch execution.
gstack has no service catalog, no ecosystem registry, no pre-push registry check. New services/skills can be added without any registration.
gstack has no concept of agent exclusive rights. All skills can perform all operations. No delegation protocol.
gstack has no decision tree for artifact placement. Files go wherever the skill puts them. No workspace vs outputs vs framework distinction.
gstack /checkpoint captures basic state. No inter-BU handoff, no lifecycle states, no signoff protocol, no artifact validation.

summary.net_assessment: AIOX has 8 gaps (0 critical), gstack has 10 gaps (2 critical). AIOX's gaps are tactical (features). gstack's gaps are structural (governance, methodology). AIOX's foundation is stronger.
